headline: Steve Johnson cautions that many Australian 'hedge funds' are actually leveraged long-biased equity products rather than genuinely hedged strategies, and investors should understand the distinction.

quote: A lot of this stuff that you're invested in is completely the opposite to that. And my colleague, Harvey Magotti...he was not allowed to be net long anything. If he wanted to buy Airbus, he had to sell Boeing in exactly the same amount.
